name: Plug in any LLM transport
description: The AI steps are transport-free: prompts, schemas and deterministic converters behind one AskJson function that takes the step, system prompt, user content and schema and returns JSON. Any transport works (an API, an in-browser model, a test double), and createLastro also accepts a custom extractor or deriver, including static ones. Nothing the LLM returns is trusted: quotes are anchored, LSL is validated and plans are checked.
